scan_id.description: The scan to report; absent lists scans.

shape.description: review_queue: distinct files with allegations and evidence; coverage: unknown, partial and excluded paths. summary retains legacy chunk scores; findings pages chunk evidence.

worst.description: summary: how many lowest-index legacy chunks to list (default 10), not distinct files.

cursor.description: findings: next_cursor of the previous page.

page_bytes.description: Maximum bytes of page entries (default 131072); metadata is additional.

min_severity.description: findings: leave out findings below this severity.

path.description: findings: a folder or glob; * within a name, ** for any depth. Dot or absent is every file.

lane.description: review_queue: one concern lane; absent combines both, correctness first. Ordering is an unvalidated candidate.

page_cursor.description: review_queue or coverage: opaque next_page_cursor; changed evidence or query requires a fresh first page.

limit.description: review_queue or coverage: maximum entries per page, default 20.
